title: After the Arima Kinen: Long-Awaited Victory

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd goes wild over Matikanetannhauser's win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She dedicates her long-awaited victory to the crowd, and the Arima Kinen comes to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we leave Nakayama Racecourse, a girl we've never seen before approaches us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "I'm the slowest in my club, and I have no talent, but I won't let that stop me! I want to do my best, just like you, Machitan!" Hearing that, Matikanetannhauser fills with glee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "I guess you could say I'm her star," she whispers as we watch the girl walk off.
